facts.text: Anderson's Tri-S travel program, founded in 1964, provides cross-cultural learning and service opportunities across the globe.

sources.title: Tri-S - Anderson University
sources.quote: Anderson University's travel program provides opportunities for students to learn and serve in cross-cultural settings. The Tri-S program began in 1964.
